## Gadajdu (CR 1)

**XP** 400  
CE Medium humanoid  
**Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception +5  


**Defense**


**AC** 13, touch 11, flat-footed 12 (+1 Dex, +2 natural)  
**hp** 16 (3d8+3)  
**Fort** +4, **Ref** +4, **Will** +2; **Weaknesses** light sensitivity  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., climb 30 ft.  
**Melee** bite +4 (1d3+2), slam +4 (1d4+2 plus grab)  
**Special Attacks** clinging bite  


**Statistics**


**Str** 15, **Dex** 13, **Con** 12, **Int** 8, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +4 (+8 grapple); **CMD** 15  
**Feats** Great Fortitude, Skill Focus (Stealth)  
**Skills** Climb +14, Perception +5, Stealth +8  
**Languages** Gadajdu  
**SQ** compression, expert climber  


**Special Abilities**



**Clinging Bite (Ex)** A gadajdu has a +2 circumstance bonus on attack rolls with its bite against a target it is grappling.  

**Expert Climber (Ex)** A gadajdu can climb virtually any surface, no matter how slick or sheer. In effect, the gadajdu is treated as constantly under a natural version of the spell spider climb with a climb speed of 30 feet.
